uses.text: The receptionist will welcome the visitor and make a brief introduction.
uses.context: A workplace prepares for a visitor.

matches.classification: Retain ambiguity between introducing people and introductory material; do not accept sense binding.
matches.individual_observation: The receptionist and visitor make a people introduction plausible, but a brief introductory welcome talk also fits. Preserve the existing selected focus without certifying it; the revised lexeme example does not resolve this expression.

uses.text: The voicemail message gives my extension; I also sent an email about our phone call.
uses.context: A worker follows up on a telephone conversation.

matches.classification: Existing selected focus compatible with this ordinary sense; preserve it without granting acceptance.
matches.individual_observation: The recorded message conveys information to a person; retain the exact existing message focus.

matches.classification: Existing selected focus compatible with this ordinary sense; preserve it without granting acceptance.
matches.individual_observation: Sent an email is one electronic communication, not the service or verb; keep the existing focus.

matches.classification: Existing selected focus compatible with this ordinary sense; preserve it without granting acceptance.
matches.individual_observation: The context explicitly says telephone conversation; retain that existing focus.

matches.classification: Retain ambiguity of the voicemail modifier; do not certify the countable-message binding.
matches.individual_observation: The whole phrase names a recorded message, but attributive voicemail can identify the recording system rather than itself instantiate the countable message. Preserve this existing focus without accepting the sense alignment.

matches.classification: Existing selected focus compatible with this ordinary sense; preserve it without granting acceptance.
matches.individual_observation: A number given for follow-up clearly supports the internal telephone-number reading; no dialing rule is inferred.

uses.text: The agenda includes a discussion of customer feedback and a supplier update.
uses.context: A team prepares to review service and deliveries.

matches.classification: Existing selected focus compatible with this ordinary sense; preserve it without granting acceptance.
matches.individual_observation: A team agenda schedules an exchange about feedback and deliveries. Retain this conversational discussion focus, without accepting agenda decisions or specialist content.

uses.text: Parse the message, deserialize its contents, split the text into fields, and serialize the final result.
uses.context: A developer explains a message-processing step.

matches.classification: Distinct sense or modality; exclude it from the selected sense without changing the expression.
matches.individual_observation: Parsing and serialization describe structured machine data. No recipient-directed human message binding follows from the token.

uses.text: Check the environment variable, file path, directory, filename, file extension, and encoding.
uses.context: A team investigates an invented import issue.

matches.classification: Distinct sense or modality; exclude it from the selected sense without changing the expression.
matches.individual_observation: File extension is a filename marker, not an internal phone number.

uses.text: I am the registered nurse; this healthcare assistant will join our discussion about your neck and chest discomfort.
uses.context: A nurse introduces a colleague during a discussion of reported discomfort.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Joining the discussion indicates an exchange about reported discomfort. Preserve the care-team identities and medical gates; the noun accepts no clinical interpretation.

uses.text: The training discussion covers contamination, cross-contamination, transmission, and infection prevention.
uses.context: A trainer presents a communication exercise.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The trainer presents a discussion exercise. Topic compatibility does not validate infection-prevention content or practical procedures.

uses.text: The consent form records the discussion, and the specimen label and laboratory request identify the sample and investigation.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The form records an exchange. It does not itself establish consent, sample validity or investigation authority.

uses.text: The resident asked the caregiver to include a family member and a companion in the conversation.
uses.context: A resident chooses who joins a discussion.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The resident chooses participants in an exchange. Retain the conversational reading and exact choice wording without adding a scored focus or care approval.

uses.text: The discharge planning discussion includes the discharge destination and transport arrangement.
uses.context: An adult participates in planning after a care episode.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The adult participates in a planning exchange. No discharge destination or transport decision is approved.

uses.text: Would you prefer live chat or a supported messaging app for this conversation?
uses.context: An agent checks the customer's preference.

matches.classification: Derived verb/activity modifier is not the selected noun; no binding inferred.
matches.individual_observation: Messaging in messaging app is an activity modifier inside an independent product-category term, not an occurrence of the selected message noun.

matches.classification: Distinct sense or modality; exclude it from the selected sense without changing the expression.
matches.individual_observation: Live chat explicitly supports text exchange; the alternative app does not establish speech. Keep this broader conversation usage distinct from the selected spoken sense.

uses.text: I will listen, acknowledge your message, record the concern, apologize for the delay, and respond through the agreed channel.
uses.context: An agent acknowledges a delayed reply.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: Acknowledging a received message fits recipient-directed information, with no acceptance of the complete response process.

uses.text: Please demonstrate how to mute or unmute, explain why you need to hold the caller, and agree when to resume the conversation.
uses.context: An agent practices describing a call interruption.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: Muting, holding the caller and resuming establish an audio exchange. Retain it without approving call-handling procedure.

uses.text: The acknowledgment confirms receipt; the summary and confirmation message explain the agreed details.
uses.context: An agent explains three message purposes.

matches.classification: Compatible component of an independent complete term; do not accept that term or add a selected binding.
matches.individual_observation: Confirmation message is an independent complete term. Its ordinary communication component does not certify the confirmed facts or add a selected binding.

uses.text: Please send only the relevant error message or error code through the approved route; redact any screenshot first.
uses.context: An agent requests suitable diagnostic context.

matches.classification: Compatible component of an independent complete term; do not accept that term or add a selected binding.
matches.individual_observation: Error message is a complete diagnostic-output term. The request concerns information shown to a person, but source interpretation and redaction requirements remain separate.

uses.text: Ask the facilities team about the extension lead before changing this workstation.

matches.classification: Distinct sense or modality; exclude it from the selected sense without changing the expression.
matches.individual_observation: Extension lead is an electrical assembly, never a telephone-number use. Preserve facilities authorization.

uses.text: Please listen as I dictate the corrected introduction, then transcribe the approved recording and clarify any unclear wording.
uses.context: An administrator prepares a written version of approved material.

matches.classification: Retain ambiguity between introducing people and introductory material; do not accept sense binding.
matches.individual_observation: A corrected introduction being dictated and transcribed is likely opening material, but could also script a people introduction. No people-sense binding or definition broadening is justified.

uses.text: Do not post a password or one-time code in a message; ask the authorized administrator to check your permission level.
uses.context: A worker asks an authorized administrator about account access.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: A posted communication is an ordinary message. The warning and permission-level gates are preserved exactly.

uses.text: The out-of-office message should use the approved alternative contact and avoid unnecessary personal details.

matches.classification: Compatible component of an independent complete term; do not accept that term or add a selected binding.
matches.individual_observation: The complete out-of-office message term names an automatic notice. Preserve its purpose and alternative-contact/privacy wording.

uses.text: I will forward your message, follow up with the responsible team, escalate unresolved concerns, and respond with the update they confirm.
uses.context: A worker coordinates a concern through the agreed route.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: Forwarding a received communication fits the selected message noun; escalation, responsibility and update accuracy remain separate.

uses.text: Ask the approved provider to translate the text or interpret the conversation; document only the information needed for the authorized purpose.
uses.context: A worker uses the approved provider and records only authorized information.

matches.classification: Retain unspecified modality; selected spoken conversation does not cover a signed exchange.
matches.individual_observation: Interpretation can involve spoken or signed language in the focused interpret lexeme. This text does not establish modality. Preserve the expression and limit selected conversation compatibility to speech; do not erase signed-language scope.

uses.text: Do not share a password in a message; use the approved support button to report a user account problem.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: A communication in which a password could be shared fits the noun. Preserve the account-access safeguard and interface-button sense.

uses.text: The training discussion covers the vehicle's blind spot and its specific load restraint arrangements.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Training involves an exchange about vehicle risks. Lexical review provides no load-restraint or driving-safety approval.

uses.text: The discussion distinguishes rhyme from morphology and connects both topics with meaningful literacy activities.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: A language-learning exchange distinguishes rhyme and morphology. No morphology graph or pedagogical activity is accepted by this noun review.

uses.text: We can teach learners to read a short message and write a reply, then discuss what they learn.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: Reading a message and writing a reply is an ordinary written communication exchange. The discuss verb does not create a discussion-noun match.

uses.text: Adapt the card activity to include everyone, guide the discussion, and ask learners to sort and match the pictures.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Guiding a group exchange fits the discussion noun. Inclusion and adaptation requirements remain exact and unreviewed here.

uses.text: The discussion considers comprehension, handwriting, and mark making as related but different aspects of learning.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Reviewing learning observations supports a topic-focused exchange. No claim about literacy assessment is accepted.

uses.text: The professional boundary discussion covered confidentiality, privacy, and data privacy in their different contexts.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Staff training considers professional and information boundaries. Lexical compatibility does not establish privacy compliance.

uses.text: Use the search field and filter to locate the template, then check the secure message and consent record before the authorized data export.

matches.classification: Compatible component of an independent complete term; do not accept that term or add a selected binding.
matches.individual_observation: Secure message is a complete term whose security depends on controls. Message compatibility does not establish security, consent or export authorization.

uses.text: Who can mediate an inclusive, transparent discussion with voluntary participation?
uses.context: Considering mediation arrangements without promising an outcome.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Mediation involves an exchange with voluntary participation. This accepts no mediation outcome or professional role.

uses.text: The resignation letter begins the discussion of offboarding and the exit interview.
uses.context: Coordinating a departure without inventing mandatory procedures.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The letter initiates an exchange about departure. Neither an obligatory exit process nor employment advice is inferred.

uses.text: The hose, stepladder, and extension lead require the relevant authorization before any planned use.

matches.classification: Distinct sense or modality; exclude it from the selected sense without changing the expression.
matches.individual_observation: The extension lead is electrical equipment. Keep this separate from the telephone-number noun and preserve authorization requirements.

uses.text: The application on the mobile device requires an authorized user account; please never send its password in a message.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: Sending information to another person fits the message noun; the password prohibition remains exact.

uses.text: The complaint and compliment both inform the service review, customer satisfaction discussion, and proposed service improvement.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The service-review setting supports an exchange about customer experience. No service result, measure or improvement is endorsed.

uses.text: The root cause analysis uses evidence; the five whys discussion alone does not prove a cause.
uses.context: Reviewing the basis of a problem-solving conclusion.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The problem-solving exchange is explicitly insufficient to prove causation. Retain that distinction and all technical gates.

uses.text: Please launch the campaign, publish the approved announcement, and distribute the current leaflet after sign-off.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: Publishing an approved information statement fits the announcement noun. The lexical candidate does not supply campaign sign-off or authority.

uses.text: The landing page should repeat the email campaign's offer and show a clear call to action.

matches.classification: Distinct sense or modality; exclude it from the selected sense without changing the expression.
matches.individual_observation: Email campaign uses email as a medium/category modifier within a complete term, not as one countable message. No selected message binding is added.

uses.text: The opt-in and opt-out should match the contact choices recorded for this message category.

matches.classification: Compatible ordinary background use; no scored binding added.
matches.individual_observation: The category concerns communications to recipients. Preserve contact choices and marketing-permission boundaries.

uses.text: Please document the discussion, record the source, identify the uncertainty and describe the finding accurately.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Documenting an exchange in a clinical note fits the ordinary noun. Source, uncertainty and finding accuracy remain protected.

uses.text: Please confirm the preferred language, interpreter request and care preference before continuing the discussion.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Continuing a consultation exchange fits discussion. Interpreter and care preferences do not become optional or clinically approved.

uses.text: The discussion should support a voluntary and informed decision, including questions about the proposed treatment option.
uses.context: Preparing a consultation under applicable requirements.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Questions in a consultation form an exchange. Valid consent, voluntariness and treatment choice remain specialist matters.

uses.text: The PPE discussion refers to the stated exposure and risk assessment, not a universal equipment choice.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The safety exchange addresses stated context. It does not prescribe universal PPE or validate the risk assessment.

uses.text: Please document the second opinion request, withdrawal of consent and agreed safety-netting discussion accurately.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: The fictional record refers to an agreed exchange. No safety-netting instructions, consent status or second-opinion decision are approved.

uses.text: The consent form records part of the discussion; it does not by itself establish valid agreement.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: A form records part of the consultation exchange. Retain the explicit limit that the form alone does not establish valid agreement.

uses.text: The clinical decision support alert requires professional review, and the acknowledgment only confirms that the message was received.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Receipt of a clinical alert is a communication event. It neither endorses the alert nor replaces professional review.

uses.text: The patient will speak with the physician and pharmacist, with an interpreter arranged for the discussion.

matches.classification: Ordinary noun in specialist context; the complete expression and specialist gates remain unaccepted.
matches.individual_observation: Speaking with professionals and an interpreter gives a consultation exchange. Roles, accessibility and clinical decisions remain outside this review.

other_local_expressions.text: Please send your availability so our coordinator can update the team schedule.
other_local_expressions.context: A team is arranging shared work.
other_local_expressions.individual_observation: No fourth-ten surface or focus match. Preserve availability scheduling, the update verb and exact third-ten source history.

other_local_expressions.text: My shift includes a break before my appointment with the manager.
other_local_expressions.context: A worker discusses the day's arrangements.
other_local_expressions.individual_observation: No fourth-ten surface or focus match. Preserve shift, break and appointment language and all pending gates.

other_local_expressions.text: Our employer has invited every employee and contractor to the meeting.
other_local_expressions.context: An organization announces an inclusive meeting.
other_local_expressions.individual_observation: The context describes announcing a meeting, but no selected announcement noun occurs or is focused. Infer no new binding.

other_local_expressions.text: Please ask your supervisor for permission to change the task's deadline and priority.
other_local_expressions.context: A worker reviews a task's arrangements.
other_local_expressions.individual_observation: No fourth-ten match. Supervisor remains an unchanged pending hold; permission, deadline and priority remain exact.

other_local_expressions.text: The client's address is included in the invitation.
other_local_expressions.context: A colleague prepares for a client visit.
other_local_expressions.individual_observation: No fourth-ten match. An invitation can be a message but does not become a selected message binding by implication.

other_local_expressions.text: My colleague is our contact for questions about each department's role and responsibility.
other_local_expressions.context: A new worker learns whom to ask about team responsibilities.
other_local_expressions.individual_observation: No fourth-ten match. Contact is the helpful-person noun, not a message or telephone event.

other_local_expressions.text: Please check the calendar, location, and time zone before accepting the invitation.
other_local_expressions.individual_observation: No fourth-ten match. Preserve organizer, location, time-zone and invitation meanings without inferring a communication channel.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A control used to request assistance from staff.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The patient asked where the call button was.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An assistance control requests staff attention; it is not a completed telephone conversation.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A person who can provide information, help, or a connection to an organization.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Our main contact is the project coordinator.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A helpful person is distinct from a message, device or act of communication.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: To communicate with a person or organization.
related_entry_boundaries.example: I will contact the supplier about the missing box.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The verb can involve calls or messages, but it is not any selected communication noun.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A message from a system drawing attention to an event or change.
related_entry_boundaries.example: A notification appeared when the order was ready.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A system alert may be a message; its narrower event/change purpose remains a separate identity.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A phone call made in response to an earlier request or conversation.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The service team arranged a callback for the customer.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A return call is a specific phone-call purpose; the complete term and timing are not accepted here.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A unit of code that expresses an action or declaration.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The statement assigns the new value.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The code instruction is not an announcement or public information statement.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A function supplied for another operation to call at a specified point.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The callback runs when the operation completes.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A supplied handler function is unrelated to telephone conversation despite the same callback spelling.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A suffix of a filename commonly used to indicate its format or intended handling.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The file extension is .json.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A filename ending is not a phone number; file formats and technical gates remain exact.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An engineer assigned to respond to relevant service issues during a scheduled period.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The on-call engineer received the approved incident summary.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Duty availability describes a role arrangement, not an actual conversation.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Communication that includes confirmation that the intended message was received and understood.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The exercise practiced closed-loop communication.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Confirmation of understanding is a whole process; a message definition supplies no process acceptance.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A tool that helps someone communicate or understand information.
related_entry_boundaries.example: She chose the communication aid that worked for her.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An aid may support speech, writing or other modes and must not be narrowed to spoken conversation.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A personal document explaining how someone communicates and what support they prefer.
related_entry_boundaries.example: She chose what to include in her communication passport.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A preference profile can cover different communication modes; selected spoken language does not restrict it.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A book used by authorized people to record and exchange relevant messages.
related_entry_boundaries.example: He checked who was authorized to read the communication book.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A shared message record is written and subject to reader authorization, not a spoken conversation.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A device used to speak with someone at a distance over a communication network.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The agent reported a telephone fault before taking calls.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The device supports calls but remains distinct from the call event, message and internal number.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A text conversation in which participants exchange messages with little delay.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The customer chose live chat instead of a phone call.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The definition explicitly uses text conversation. Preserve that broader usage and do not bind it to the selected spoken exchange.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A group of telephone calls waiting to be connected or handled.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The supervisor checked the call queue.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Waiting connections can precede any conversation. Do not require or imply that every queued call has been answered.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An application used to send and receive messages.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The customer asked which messaging app the service supports.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An application supports messages; the derived modifier is not the selected message noun or proof of a spoken channel.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A message stating that a detail or arrangement has been confirmed.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The agent sent a confirmation message for the agreed callback.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A communication can confirm details, but the facts and confirmation process need their own review.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A period during which a return phone call is expected or arranged.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The agent confirmed the callback window and time zone.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The time interval is not the call itself and gives no guarantee that contact occurs.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A message indicating that an operation encountered a problem.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The agent asked for the relevant error message without unrelated personal data.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A diagnostic report can inform a recipient; its technical meaning is not accepted by ordinary message review.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: The number of calls counted over a defined period under stated inclusion rules.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The supervisor checked whether call volume included abandoned calls.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The measure may count unanswered or abandoned calls. Preserve its stated inclusion-rule boundary.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Work associated with a call that is completed after the conversation, such as recording agreed actions.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The agent used after-call work time to finish the factual record.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Post-conversation work remains a distinct task category, not a synonym for the call.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An electrical cable assembly used to extend the reach of a power connection.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Ask the facilities team about the damaged extension lead.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An electrical cable assembly is wholly separate from the phone-number sense; retain all equipment-safety gates.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A telephone designed to support conversations involving several people in a room.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The conference phone is on the meeting table.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The meeting device enables group calls but is not the conversation or discussion itself.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A greeting at the beginning of a letter or message.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Please check that the salutation matches the recipient.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A letter opening can be a greeting in a broader sense; it is not the selected acknowledgment on meeting or arrival.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A message indicating that someone is away or unavailable, often sent automatically.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The out-of-office message gives an approved alternative contact.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An automatic absence notice is a specific message type. Keep privacy and approved-contact boundaries.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: To receive an arriving person in a friendly and positive way.
related_entry_boundaries.example: We welcome guests and ask how we can help.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The action of receiving a person is distinct from a greeting noun or act of introducing people.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: To acknowledge someone with words or a suitable gesture when meeting them.
related_entry_boundaries.example: Greet the guest and introduce yourself.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The verb describes acknowledgment; no morphology or noun/participle answer equivalence is inferred.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A message handled through specified protective controls, whose security depends on the actual service and configuration.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The report should use the organization's approved secure message service.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Message meaning supplies no security guarantee; protection depends on actual service and controls.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A caller using deception for a dishonest purpose.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The reported fraudulent caller claimed to be from technical support.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A caller is a person rather than a call or voicemail, and deception claims remain independently bounded.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A region of an interface that shows selected status indicators and notification controls.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The network indicator is in the notification area.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An interface area displays alerts and controls, not a communication event or physical greeting.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A software component that adds or changes functions in a web browser.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The browser extension requires an approval review.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A browser component adds functionality; it is not a telephone number.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An activity intended to deepen or broaden learning beyond the initial task.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The extension activity asks learners to explain another possibility.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A learning extension broadens activity and does not use the internal-number meaning.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An audio call involving several participants in different places.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The conference call includes colleagues from three offices.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: An audio call with several participants is compatible with the phone-call family but retains its complete identity.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: An interview conducted through an audio telephone call.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The telephone interview is scheduled for tomorrow.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The interview specifies a purpose and audio channel; no interview procedure is accepted here.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A collection of information or materials for someone joining an organization.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The welcome pack explains the first-day arrangements.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: A collection of joining materials is not a greeting or introduction act despite its welcoming purpose.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: Communication explaining a proposed or agreed change.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The change communication distinguishes decisions from proposals.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: Change information may be communicated through messages or announcements, but proposal versus decision remains exact.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A telephone or online conversation about a possible sale.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The sales call focused on the customer's requirements.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The complete sales contact includes telephone or online possibilities; do not assume a selected spoken phone call in every online use.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A message inviting an audience to take a specific next action.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The call to action invites readers to request a demonstration.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The call is an invitation, not a telephone event. Its message purpose grants no permission to perform the requested action.

related_entry_boundaries.definition: A coordinated marketing activity using email messages.
related_entry_boundaries.example: The email campaign is limited to the intended permission-based list.
related_entry_boundaries.individual_observation: The term concerns an activity using a communication medium and multiple messages, not one selected email message.
